description: DeepBook's markets, read live from its public indexer. Without a pool: every pool with its last price, 24h change, high, low and volume, best bid and ask, and activity (only "active" is a live market; "empty_book" and "no_recent_trades" aren't). With a pool name (e.g. "SUI_USDC"): its best price levels each side, spread, depth within 2% of mid, whether it's a live market, and its latest trades. Market data, not advice; nothing here places orders. To trade, use the DeepBook SDK with your own wallet (ask_sui "deepbook place limit order").

pool.description: A pool name like "SUI_USDC" (any case). Leave it out to list every pool.
